visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a lilac-colored ski jacket and a black beanie, stands in a vast, snow-covered mountain landscape. She poses shyly, covering her mouth with her hand. (2) The camera zooms out to reveal a group of friends who suddenly appear and dance energetically behind her, striking various humorous poses. The background features a wooden ski lodge and distant mountains covered in pine trees. (3) The scene transitions to a montage of the woman practicing snowboarding. She is seen falling on the soft snow, laughing while her friends help her up. (4) Shots of her snowboarding down a gentle slope are shown, alternating with close-ups of her face wearing orange-tinted ski goggles. (5) Interior shots follow, showing the woman shopping in a brightly lit convenience store and later sitting in a restaurant area with a tray of Japanese food, including curry and soup. (6) The video concludes with the group posing together on a ski lift and more clips of her successfully navigating the slopes as the sun sets, casting a soft light over the snowy peaks.

(5) The narrator's voice remains consistent in tone, accompanied by the persistent acoustic guitar background music and occasional ambient indoor restaurant chatter.
